subject.title: Cron running_at_ms not cleared after agentTurn run

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81572 be treated as the canonical fix for this latest-release recurring isolated `agentTurn` `running_at_ms` report, or should maintainers require an exact live/current-main reproduction first?
rationale: The issue is concrete and current, but source inspection shows both the intended clear path and a separate batch-buffering gap; choosing the canonical fix path requires maintainer judgment on proof sufficiency.

options.title: Validate Then Adapt PR 81572
options.body: Add or require an exact scheduled isolated `agentTurn` SQLite regression/live proof, then rebase or adapt the incremental persistence fix if it covers the report.

options.title: Require Fresh Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on a live v2026.6.11 or current-main reproduction before changing the scheduler again.

options.title: Track Separately From PR 81572
options.body: Treat the report as a distinct single-job cron persistence bug if maintainers determine the batch-buffering fix does not explain it.

recommendation.title: Validate Then Adapt PR 81572
recommendation.body: Add or require an exact scheduled isolated `agentTurn` SQLite regression/live proof, then rebase or adapt the incremental persistence fix if it covers the report.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest semantic history around cron running-state repair and scheduler state routing points to steipete's prior cron work.
